'''Kluuus''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] soldier who served the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Len Markus]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The [[Darkstaff]] imbued Markus with some of the powers of a [[Sith battlelord]], allowing him to not be hurt when Kluuus was alive and within thirty meters of him, as injuries inflicted on him, would instead appear on Kluuus.

He was killed near the [[Ch'hala tree|Ch'hala]] [[Heart Tree]], when Markus was attacked by the [[Heroes of Cularin]] there in 19 BBY.
